title: Book Three · Chapter 84: The Longer Visit
story:
A little over a week after his birthday, Ronan receives Leo's fourteenth reply.

He opens it near the yard door. The new football is beside his chair. The little white mark is easy to find now.

Leo asks about the birthday first. Then he writes about summer.

My aunt wants three weeks with my grandmother this time. I can come too. We plan to arrive on the first Saturday of your holiday and leave on the fourth Saturday.

Ronan reads the two days again. Three weeks, not four nights.

Leo has another thought below them.

Some of my old books are still at my grandmother's. They are mine. I don't read those stories now. The man near our station sells used books. Could we try a few together?

Ronan looks toward his own shelf. He has a few ordinary books he no longer reads. His birthday book is there too, with the class photo safely inside.

He puts a hand on the letter. He can picture a little table and people stopping beside it.

That evening, Dad brings home the next work sheet. Mr Sun has finished the review. Thursdays will end at five again, just like Tuesdays. The other days stay the same.

Mum puts the sheet beside the household page.

“Both afternoons back,” she says.

Dad nods. “There are more jobs waiting.”

They check the costs before they put any money aside. The old tool stays on Dad's list for now.

Ronan waits until they finish. Then he shows them Leo's letter.

“Three weeks?” Mum asks.

“With his aunt and grandmother. Not all here.”

She smiles. “I understood that part.”

Dad reads the line about the books.

“How many?”

“I don't know yet. A few of ours first.”

“And the money?”

Ronan looks at his small envelope. He can choose a part of his own savings. He does not know the book prices yet.

“We need to look.”

Dad gives the letter back. “Then look before you buy.”

After dinner, Ronan starts his answer. He checks the holiday dates on the school sheet. The first Saturday is right.

He writes about the football and the blue bracelet. Then he asks about the three weeks and the bus times.

At the bottom, he adds one line about the books.

I want to try. We need our own small amount of money and a place for the table.

He leaves the letter open while he checks the school dates once more. Outside, Dad is putting away his work shoes. Tomorrow will be another full work day.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

review＝复看、重新检查；used book＝旧书、二手书；amount＝数额；savings＝积蓄、储蓄存款。

## 理解问题

1. Dad后一次工时复看有什么结果？是否代表全家突然有很多闲钱？
2. Leo希望住多久、住在哪里？卖书计划这时有没有已经买好大批库存？

## 读句子

**He can choose a part of his own savings.**

拆开看：He / can choose a part / of his own savings.

他／可以拿出其中一部分／拿出自己攒下的钱中的一部分。
